title: The Fourth, 2008
logline: White fireworks. Chloe is on the dock — in town for the mill walk a month early. She sits in the lawn chair before anyone can stop her.

panels.composition: The dock, fireworks white on blue. CHLOE, the camel coat over her arm, walking straight to the lawn chair under the eave and sitting in it. GULLY frozen mid-pour. WOOD on the steps.

image.prompt: a crowded dock at night under white fireworks, a woman with short expensive hair sitting down in an old green-webbed lawn chair under a shack's eave, a man in an apron frozen mid-pour, a thin man on the steps with a dog, muddy watercolor
image.notes: The first person to sit in the chair since the uncle. She doesn't know. Nobody tells her.

panels.composition: Gully and Wood exchanging a look over the crowd. Gully's tiny head-shake: leave it.

image.prompt: close-up of two men exchanging a look across a crowd, one giving a tiny head-shake, no words

panels.composition: Chloe in the chair, looking up. Barnaby climbing into her lap. She lets him.

characters.pose: in the chair, dog in lap

balloons.text: This chair's older than the shop.

image.prompt: a woman in a lawn chair with an old dog climbing into her lap, looking up at fireworks

panels.composition: The finale. White. The chair, occupied, at last, by someone who doesn't know what it means. Everyone lets her.
props: the chair with Chloe and the dog

image.prompt: a fireworks finale in white over a blue night bay above a crowded dock, a woman in an old lawn chair under a shack's eave with a dog in her lap, watercolor, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; Sundays the point

notes: Chloe sits in the chair. 'It's yours tonight.' Nobody tells her.
